required_workflow: Read AGENTS.md and the full game chapter for the target year.
Apply the 1833 owner mandate: elite primary contributor, no support-only architecture, no turret; establish event stage, partners and actual resources.
No pneumatic actuation for 1833. Respect historical scope; 2018/2019 now have thirteen curated primary-source studies; read the scope audit and transfer guide, not an assumed top25 cohort.
For historical transfer, read HISTORICAL_2018_2019_TRANSFER.md; compare whole mechanisms and preserve current owner constraints, source/version boundaries and null historical rankings.

Prioritize independently achievable RP and owned scoring prerequisites. Use cheap spatial/analytical decisions first and justify physical tests by decision value and iteration cost; preserve the owner four-lane decision chronology.

For each new manual analysis, material rules revision or new/revised robot design brief, follow docs/TASK_LIST_PROTOCOL.md and deliver a filled copy of the one-sheet 1833 task template before the final architecture recommendation. Preserve human decisions separately; no group tabs.

Follow DESIGN_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md: compare viable primary non-turret architectures with common timed scenarios, capacity/storage trade studies, physical envelope, row-specific dependencies and consistent release targets; apply the rubric and human review.
Search explicit year/function; inspect typed evidence, scope and source locators.
Load complete robot packets, including sibling claim fields and limitations.
Open the referenced image bytes with image-capable tools; text captions do not confer visual understanding.
Check exact version, mechanism interfaces, performance conditions and rule applicability.
Recommend a coherent architecture, alternatives, unresolved issues and a decision-changing test.
